location: Sample and Power Threshold (p. 2); Replication result, Analysis One: Focal Analysis and Table 1 (pp. 2, 4)
quote: The analytic sample included 28 observations (EU member states)
reason: The three-level multilevel replication reports both 28 Level-3 EU member-state clusters (used for the power threshold and matching the original study's coded country count N=27 for the country-level unemployment predictor) and 352,114 Level-1 person-year observations in focal Analysis One (379,396 in Analysis Two) as the analytic sample. Because the codebook does not prescribe which nested level of a multilevel model must be coded for n_r and both counts validly represent distinct sample roles, the target unit is undeterminable.
